title: Directory reorganization: lib/mitosis rename and docs merge

completion_criteria.text: The blast radius is re-derived as a closed census over the CURRENT tree that halts on anything unclassifiable, and every difference from 0340's 17-site count is explained rather than absorbed.
lib/superpowers-parallel becomes lib/mitosis and resolve-superpowers.mjs becomes superpowers-prompts.mjs, every load-bearing path string changing in the SAME commit.
docs/superpowers/{specs,plans} merge into the existing docs/{specs,plans}, and workflows/parallel-plan-execution.js becomes mitosis-execute.js together with its meta.name.
The dead .gitignore line is deleted rather than renamed, since it names a path nothing writes.
Behaviour-neutrality is proven by execution not inspection: drift-check hook, CI phase-parity, npm test glob, pr.mjs imports and mitosis.js LIB_DIR all resolve after the move.
A PR is opened through the centralized pr-create tool from a worktree branch, the primary checkout never leaves main, and phase 2 subdivision is left undone.

key_decisions.title: The rename executes now in a child thread and a worktree, with the blast radius re-derived rather than trusted
